title: Circuit Satisfiability and 3-SAT
statement: For a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables, the circuit is satisfiable if and only if the 3-CNF formula obtained by converting its Tseitin CNF encoding to 3-CNF is satisfiable.
hypotheses_covered: A circuit tree on some natural number $n$ of variables
